metrics.name: total_reward
metrics.description: Sum of harvest_reward across all decisions. Random foraging averages around the per-stay mean (~50) times the prop-stay (~0.5) times n_trials. MVT-following humans should substantially exceed this.

metrics.name: prop_stay_overall
metrics.description: Proportion of decisions that were STAY across both blocks (uses derived boolean is_stay field). MVT-following humans typically stay more often than random (~0.6-0.8 across patches before leaving).

metrics.name: mean_residence_time_low
metrics.description: Average number of consecutive STAY decisions per patch in the LOW-COST block. Lower under MVT because cheap travel encourages early leaving.

metrics.name: mean_residence_time_high
metrics.description: Average number of consecutive STAY decisions per patch in the HIGH-COST block. Higher under MVT because expensive travel discourages leaving.

metrics.name: mvt_optimal_match_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of decisions matching the per-trial MVT-optimal prediction (stay if current_reward >= running average, else leave). Random foraging is at chance (~0.5).
